phase_1.title: Phase 1 · CZ 75B Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 9×19mm Parabellum primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 240 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 240 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 114 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 6-groove bore and accelerates to 360 m/s (500 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Barrel Tilt Unlock & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, barrel and slide recoil locked together before the lower cam lug tilts the breech downward to unlock.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 16-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the CZ 75B staged for its 60 RPM (practical semi-auto) cadence.

zh.headline: 捷克 CZ 75B 内置滑轨全钢双排手枪：1975 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 捷克约瑟夫·考茨基兄弟设计的 CZ 75B 创造性地将套筒反包于全钢机匣导轨之内，将膛线轴心大幅压低至 28 mm，配合符合人体自然指向弧度的海狸尾握把与 16 发双排弹匣，被公认为“神奇九毫米”（Wonder Nine）的黄金巅峰。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：CZ 75B 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1975 年问世的 捷克 CZ 75B 内置滑轨全钢双排手枪 由捷克斯洛伐克捷克乌尔斯基布罗德兵工厂（Česká Zbrojovka）主导研制，定位为经典的内置全长滑轨全钢手枪。由于当年捷克斯洛伐克未能在西方申请国际专利，CZ 75 成为史上被全球各国合法仿制与致敬次数最多的手枪架构之一。
捷克约瑟夫·考茨基兄弟设计的 CZ 75B 创造性地将套筒反包于全钢机匣导轨之内，将膛线轴心大幅压低至 28 mm，配合符合人体自然指向弧度的海狸尾握把与 16 发双排弹匣，被公认为“神奇九毫米”（Wonder Nine）的黄金巅峰。 整件装备总长 206 mm（8.1 in）、空重 1 kg，成为同期手枪左轮领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1975 年，捷克斯洛伐克捷克乌尔斯基布罗德兵工厂（Česká Zbrojovka）推出了划时代的捷克 CZ 75B 内置滑轨全钢双排手枪。由于当年捷克斯洛伐克未能在西方申请国际专利，CZ 75 成为史上被全球各国合法仿制与致敬次数最多的手枪架构之一。 它的核心设计聚焦于标志性“套筒包于机匣内”全长导轨结构，降低往复质量与膛线轴心高度，奠定了其在手枪左轮发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 精密铣削往复式钢制套筒

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 捷克 CZ 75B 内置滑轨全钢双排手枪 的机械灵魂在于其「勃朗宁肾形凸轮偏移闭锁 · 套筒内嵌式全长机匣导轨」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，枪管与套筒短距共同后坐后由下凸耳引导枪管尾端下倾脱离闭锁槽，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用高温发蓝锻造合金钢精加工而成。全钢底把与深弧海狸尾握把令连发射击枪口上跳极小、回正迅疾，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。捷克 CZ 75B 内置滑轨全钢双排手枪 采用勃朗宁肾形凸轮偏移闭锁 · 套筒内嵌式全长机匣导轨。在每个击发周期中，枪管与套筒短距共同后坐后由下凸耳引导枪管尾端下倾脱离闭锁槽。借助高温发蓝锻造合金钢工艺与高强度配合，实现了全钢底把与深弧海狸尾握把令连发射击枪口上跳极小、回正迅疾。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 9×19mm Parabellum 弹药规格与 114 mm（4.5 in 冷锻钢枪管 · 6 条右旋 · 1:250 mm），最高工作膛压约 240 MPa，可赋予弹头 360 m/s 的出膛初速与 500 J 动能，有效作用距离达 50 米。
内膛技术特点方面，114 mm 冷锻 6 条右旋膛线，全钢内轨导向赋予极高连发回正稳定性。同时，双动/单动机构兼容“上膛压锤锁保险”与首发双动携行双重习惯，令其在 60 发/分（实用半自动） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 114 毫米身管与 9×19mm Parabellum 口径，捷克 CZ 75B 内置滑轨全钢双排手枪 实现了每秒 360 米的初速与 50 米有效射程。114 mm 冷锻 6 条右旋膛线，全钢内轨导向赋予极高连发回正稳定性，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 16 发容量的16 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 28 mm 膛轴设计，捷克 CZ 75B 内置滑轨全钢双排手枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 3 N·s 水平。B 型增设自动击针保险块与防滑方形扳机护圈，衍生出全球冠军 Shadow 系列。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-84）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 16 发容量的16 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与出色的整体工效，B 型增设自动击针保险块与防滑方形扳机护圈，衍生出全球冠军 Shadow 系列。欢迎在 BAY-84 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 捷克 CZ 75B 内置滑轨全钢双排手枪 的机械魅力。

en.headline: CZ 75B All-Steel Service Pistol: The 1975 Mechanical Legend
en.deck: Engineered by Josef and František Koucký, the Czech CZ 75B nests its slim slide inside full-length steel frame rails to drop the bore axis to 28 mm, uniting natural pointing ergonomics, a 16-round double-stack magazine, and cocked-and-locked DA/SA versatility. Preserved in 1:1 interactive 3D CAD scale across all 20 functional assemblies in BAY-84.

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the CZ 75B
paragraphs: Introduced in 1975 by Česká Zbrojovka Uherský Brod in Czechoslovakia, the CZ 75B All-Steel Service Pistol emerged as a defining Inside-Rail All-Steel 9mm Pistol. Because Cold War export rules left the 1975 design unpatented in the West, the CZ 75 became one of the most widely cloned and revered service pistol architectures in history.

Engineered by Josef and František Koucký, the Czech CZ 75B nests its slim slide inside full-length steel frame rails to drop the bore axis to 28 mm, uniting natural pointing ergonomics, a 16-round double-stack magazine, and cocked-and-locked DA/SA versatility. Measuring 206 mm (8.1 in) at an unloaded weight of 1 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Handgun class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1975, Česká Zbrojovka Uherský Brod of Czechoslovakia introduced the CZ 75B All-Steel Service Pistol. Because Cold War export rules left the 1975 design unpatented in the West, the CZ 75 became one of the most widely cloned and revered service pistol architectures in history. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Inverted slide-in-frame full-length rails reduce slide mass and bore axis height to 28 mm — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the CZ 75B All-Steel Service Pistol sits its Browning Kidney-Cam Short Recoil · Inverted Full-Length Inside-Frame Slide Rails. Throughout every firing cycle, barrel and slide recoil locked together before the lower cam lug tilts the breech downward to unlock, containing 240 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in hot-salt blued forged alloy steel, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, All-steel 1.0 kg chassis and contoured beavertail tame muzzle flip during rapid strings, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The CZ 75B All-Steel Service Pistol relies on Browning Kidney-Cam Short Recoil · Inverted Full-Length Inside-Frame Slide Rails. During each cycle, barrel and slide recoil locked together before the lower cam lug tilts the breech downward to unlock. Machined from hot-salt blued forged alloy steel, it delivers standout engineering reliability: All-steel 1.0 kg chassis and contoured beavertail tame muzzle flip during rapid strings.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 9×19mm Parabellum with 114 mm (4.5 in Cold-Forged Steel · 6-Groove RH · 1:250 mm), the CZ 75B All-Steel Service Pistol develops 360 m/s muzzle velocity and 500 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 50 meters.

Internally, 114 mm cold-forged 6-groove RH barrel guided by tight inside-frame rails for match tracking. Combined with its 60 RPM (practical semi-auto) tempo, DA/SA fire control supports both Condition 1 cocked-and-locked and double-action carry, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 9×19mm Parabellum through its 114 millimeter bore, the CZ 75B All-Steel Service Pistol achieves 360 meters per second and 50 meters of effective reach. 114 mm cold-forged 6-groove RH barrel guided by tight inside-frame rails for match tracking.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 16-round 16-round detachable magazine body with a 28 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 3 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. B-series firing-pin block spawned championship IPSC Production platforms worldwide.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-84), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
acts.audioScript: Act Four: Engineering Legacy. Pairing its 16-round 16-round detachable magazine body with disciplined recoil geometry, B-series firing-pin block spawned championship IPSC Production platforms worldwide. Explore BAY-84 in live section cut and exploded disassembly to study every working link of the CZ 75B All-Steel Service Pistol.
